title: Affine length bounds the conformal excursion on a null cone: a sharp focusing inequality
description: On a vacuum null cone, a generator that stays expanding within a given normalised affine length moves its conformal 2-metric, a curve in the hyperbolic plane, by less than an explicit sharp constant. We give the closed form, the unique extremal, a sharp whole-cut inequality, and consequences: a sharp patch bound, a gap in a one-loop check, higher dimensions and matter. The archive also contains the Python checks (code/) and a Lean 4 formalisation of the core inequality of Theorem 1 (lean/; drafts in lean/wip/ are not part of the verified claim).
